name: Elden Ring
description_raw:
A sprawling open-world action role-playing game. Travel across a vast land, fight enormous bosses and piece together a story told through item descriptions and chance meetings.

Summon allies, ride a spectral steed and choose from many weapons, spells and builds.

This paragraph exists so the description is long enough to be split into a preview and a read-more part, which the panel does after about three hundred characters of text.
